_README: Copy to bridge.config.json and fill in. The real file holds a bearer token and absolute local paths; it is gitignored and must never be committed. Regenerate the token with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(24).toString('hex'))"
_allowExecution: false = the bridge will only report agent availability; true = it may spawn the adapters below.
_allowedRoots: Absolute paths the bridge is permitted to touch. Anything outside is refused, including sibling folders. Widen deliberately: adding the vault root exposes every note to the local agents.
_workspaceRoot: Default cwd for agent tasks. Normally one of allowedRoots.
_adapters: CLI agents the bridge may launch. {{prompt}} is substituted with the task prompt. Keep read-only sandbox flags unless you have a specific reason to grant writes. You do not have to hand-write these: open the Settings Center in the Research Weaver app and click '检测本机 Agent' (detect local agents) to probe this machine's PATH for the known CLIs in tools/known-agents.js (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Pi, DeepSeek Harness, Kimi Code) and add any it finds with one click -- GET /v1/agents/discover and POST /v1/agents/adapters. Hand-editing below is still supported for anything not in that registry, or to customize args/sandbox for an entry it added.
_skillDirectories: Folders scanned for SKILL.md bundles exposed via /v1/skills.
_scholarium: Separate opt-in for POST /v1/scholarium/actions (rss.refresh_feed / rss.score_feed / rss.clip_high_score). enabled defaults false; this Bridge process never executes an action itself, it only whitelists+queues it under <vaultRoot>/Research/_runs/queue/ for the Scholarium plugin's own queue consumer to run (which re-checks the same whitelist and writes the same Research/_runs/actions/ audit manifest a user-initiated action would). vaultRoot must be the REAL Obsidian vault root, not a workspaceRoot subfolder like allowedRoots above, since Research/ lives at the vault root. L0 read-only actions (project.list / project.get / experiment.scan_outcomes) are the exception: they are served directly by GET /v1/scholarium/state?action=... without queueing, because they only read schema-v1 Markdown and never need a live plugin context. The same enabled/vaultRoot/allowedActions gates apply to both routes.
